approach: Static recompilation of the whole game (AArch64 to C, built natively, no emulation); NVN graphics on Vulkan; the fighters' script code as C++ source.
notes: Native Windows build made on your PC from your own dump by a one-click installer. Menus, fights with every base fighter, music, movies, controllers and the on-screen keyboard work; shaders are loaded at start. Run-ahead for lower input delay is exact but off by default. Next: online play (Local Wireless over the internet, then rollback), an in-game settings menu, items as source.
help: Testing on AMD and Intel GPUs
